staff.name: Monica Leyva
staff.description:
Hello, my name is Monica Leyva. I was born in Miami, of Cuban/Spanish descent. I've worked for many years in the healthcare setting helping people recover, and today I share my passion for elevating the beauty in others.I specialize in Eyelash Extensions, Lash & Brow Shaping, and Permanent Makeup Services, designed to enhance your natural beauty and simplify your daily routine.

At ML Esthetics, I am dedicated to providing personalized care and precision artistry, ensuring each service is tailored to your unique style and needs. Whether you’re seeking bold, voluminous lashes, perfectly shaped brows, or long-lasting makeup solutions, I deliver results that leave you feeling confident and radiant.

Elevate your beauty with effortless elegance. Book your appointment today and let ML Esthetics transform your look!

reviews.body: Did brow lamination and lash lift and tint. They look amazing, super happy! Will defo be coming back

reviews.author: Akram B…
reviews.body: Monica did a beautiful job shaping and defining my eyebrows. The result is a soft straight brow that looks clean, modern, and flattering for my face shape. The strokes are even and well‑placed, giving a natural look without appearing too heavy. I especially appreciate how she kept the brows balanced and symmetrical, with a gentle lift toward the tail that brightens my eyes. Overall, her work looks polished, youthful, and thoughtfully done.
